skill.name: ad-creative
skill.description: Creates grounded ad copy, static concepts, video scripts, creative roadmaps, and performance-based variations for major paid advertising platforms.
skill.summary: Generate and improve platform-ready ad creative using brand evidence, customer language, and campaign performance data.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

security_audit.summary: All 55 static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown, documentation links, ordinary marketing prose, or scoped API examples. Semantic review found unpinned third-party code execution, missing voice-cloning consent safeguards, and deceptive-interface risks despite existing disclosure guidance.

remediation.issue: Third-party installation examples execute unpinned remote code.
remediation.suggestion: Pin package and repository versions, verify integrity, require source review, and obtain explicit user approval before installation or execution.

remediation.issue: Voice cloning guidance does not require permission from the speaker.
remediation.suggestion: Require documented speaker consent, prohibit impersonation, and add platform-specific synthetic media disclosure checks.

remediation.issue: Interface imitation can make scripted advertisements appear authentic.
remediation.suggestion: Require visible dramatization labels, confirm trademark permissions, and prefer generic interface skins when authorization is absent.

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned Third-Party Code Execution
semantic_findings.description: The references recommend npx installation and cloning a repository before running make targets. Unpinned remote code can change and execute with user permissions.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both documented workflows execute third-party package or repository code without a pinned version, integrity check, or review requirement.

semantic_findings.title: Voice Cloning Lacks Consent Safeguards
semantic_findings.description: The guide recommends cloning a brand spokesperson from short audio samples. It does not require documented consent or prohibit impersonation.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cloning capability and intended advertising use are explicit, while the reviewed guidance contains no consent requirement.

semantic_findings.title: Deceptive Interface Imitation Risk
semantic_findings.description: The workflow recreates trusted chat interfaces and authentic sounds to delay ad recognition. Sponsored placement guidance reduces but does not remove impersonation risk.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The persuasion intent and detailed interface imitation are explicit. The same file also provides disclosure and grounding controls.

content.user_title: Create High-Performing Ad Creative at Scale
content.value_statement: Producing varied, platform-ready ads requires strong evidence, precise limits, and repeatable testing. This skill turns product context and performance data into grounded creative batches.
actual_capabilities: Generates headlines, descriptions, primary text, and complete variations for major advertising platforms.
Organizes creative by audience angle and includes character counts for platform limits.
Analyzes supplied campaign metrics to identify winning themes and produce informed iterations.
Builds grounded static ad concept batches from winning ads, reviews, comments, and brand assets.
Creates hook matrices, video scripts, production briefs, and evidence-ranked creative roadmaps.
Recommends image, video, voice, and code-based production tools for different creative needs.
limitations: It requires accurate product context, brand guidance, and substantiated claims from the user.
It cannot guarantee clicks, conversions, or return on advertising spend.
External generation services require separate accounts, credentials, permissions, and usage review.
Platform specifications and vendor pricing can change, so users must verify them before launch.

use_cases.title: Launch a New Campaign
use_cases.description: Create platform-ready angles, headlines, descriptions, and primary text from a product brief and verified offer details.

use_cases.title: Refresh Winning Creative
use_cases.description: Analyze supplied performance data and generate controlled variations that extend proven themes while testing new angles.

use_cases.title: Plan a Creative Production Slate
use_cases.description: Turn customer language, campaign signals, and production capacity into ranked static and video concepts.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Starter Ad Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Create ads for [product] on [platform]. Target [audience] with [offer]. Use this brand voice: [voice]. Ask for any missing essential facts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner creation from a short campaign brief

prompt_templates.title: Adapt Copy Across Platforms
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt this verified message for Google Ads, Meta, and LinkedIn: [message]. Respect each platform limit. Group outputs by angle and include character counts.

prompt_templates.title: Iterate From Performance Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these ad results using [primary metric]: [data]. Identify winning and losing patterns. Create controlled variations and explain the hypothesis behind each test.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Evidence-Ranked Creative Roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a monthly creative roadmap from these campaign results, customer quotes, organic signals, and production limits: [inputs]. Rank concepts by evidence and assign production tiers.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced creative strategy and capacity planning

output_examples.input: Create Google Ads copy for a reporting tool that saves verified users ten hours weekly.
output: Description: Build accurate reports automatically and give your team ten hours back each week. (82 characters)

output_examples.input: Review Meta ad results where customer-quote ads have the highest conversion rate.
output_examples.output: Finding: Specific customer language converts better than feature-led copy. Next test: keep the same offer and compare three verified quote themes.

output_examples.input: Plan five static concepts using reviews, winning ads, and customer objections.
output_examples.output: A ranked concept slate with one evidence source, audience motivation, visual template, headline direction, and test metric for each concept.

best_practices: Provide verified product facts, customer language, brand rules, platform, format, and audience before generation.
Change one creative variable per test and evaluate the full funnel before selecting winners.
Verify character limits, claims, disclosures, permissions, and landing-page consistency before launch.
anti_patterns: Do not invent statistics, testimonials, customer outcomes, or urgency.
Do not create many near-identical variations while leaving audience angles untested.
Do not execute external installation or generation commands without reviewing sources and obtaining approval.

faq.question: Which advertising platforms does this skill support?
faq.answer: It covers Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and X, with platform-specific formats and copy limits.

faq.question: Can it improve existing advertisements?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide creative results and the primary metric, and it can identify patterns and propose controlled variations.

faq.question: Does it generate images or videos directly?
faq.answer: It can design concepts, prompts, scripts, and production workflows. Actual asset generation depends on configured external tools.

faq.question: What source material produces the best results?
faq.answer: Use recent winning advertisements, verified customer reviews, campaign comments, brand assets, offer details, and performance data.

faq.question: Does it guarantee advertising performance?
faq.answer: No. It structures evidence-based creative tests, but audience response, media buying, offer quality, and landing pages affect results.

faq.question: How does it handle claims and testimonials?
faq.answer: It requires claims to use verified sources and prohibits invented statistics, endorsements, testimonials, or customer outcomes.
